summary: Built ContractRepositoryPage (src/pages/ContractRepositoryPage.jsx) matching IMG-1: breadcrumb (Home Page / CLM Hub / Contract Repository), title and subtitle, SearchFilterPanel (Search Box, Status Filter, Date Range Filter, Value Filter, Folder/Tag Filter, Search Button), and a sortable ContractListTable with the exact Contract Name/Counterparty/Status/Value/Start Date/End Date/Owner/Last Modified columns and 'Showing X-Y of N contracts…' footer caption. Implemented NoResultsMessage and EmptyRepositoryState, correctly distinguishing a no-match search (UC8-AF-001) from a genuinely empty repository with filters disabled (UC8-AF-002), plus an IndexingInProgressBanner for the full-text-search exclusion notice (UC8-AF-004). Wired every call through the existing contractRepositoryService.js (GET /api/v1/contracts, GET /api/v1/folder-tags) via a new useContractSearch hook backed by a new contractRepositorySlice zustand store, and reused the existing useFolderTagOptions hook and AddFolderTagDialog component. Row click navigates to the existing /contracts/:contractId route (ContractDetailPage, built by a sibling task). Routed at the new /contract-repository path since uc123's existing /contracts route already serves its own ContractRepositoryListPage and that module must not be rewritten. Verified with lint (0 warnings), the full vitest suite (89/89 passing, including 4 new tests for loading/populated/empty-repository/no-results states), a production build, and live screenshots against a disposable local mock backend (not part of the app) for both the populated and empty-repository states — both match IMG-1 closely (breadcrumb, filter layout and labels, table columns, status badge colors, footer caption).

pr.title: feat(ui-gen): add ContractRepositoryPage with search, filter and sort
pr.body: Implements ContractRepositoryPage (UC8-MF-001 / UC8-AF-001 / UC8-AF-002 / UC8-AF-004 and related BR/FV stories): the Contract Repository list screen with Search Box, Status Filter, Date Range Filter, Value Filter, Folder/Tag Filter, a sortable Contract List Table, and the no-results / empty-repository / indexing-in-progress states. Routed at /contract-repository (new path — /contracts is already owned by the uc123 module's ContractRepositoryListPage). Row click opens the existing ContractDetailPage at /contracts/:contractId.

blockers: Route path: the module contract names the page 'ContractRepositoryPage' but gives no explicit route. The uc123 module already owns the '/contracts' route (ContractRepositoryListPage, a different component with different DTOs) which CLAUDE.md forbids rewriting, so I mounted this new page at '/contract-repository' instead. I then updated two already-built sibling-task files' internal links (ContractDetailPage.jsx's breadcrumb and AccessDeniedView.jsx's back-link, plus its test's expected href) from '/contracts' to '/contract-repository' so this module's own cross-links are internally consistent — these are the only edits made to files outside this task's ownership, and both were one-line link-target changes, not rewrites.

Date Range Filter: the design (IMG-1) shows a single combined date-range control ('01/01/2026 – 31/12/2026'), but ContractSearchRequest has two independent pairs (startDateFrom/startDateTo and endDateFrom/endDateTo). I mapped the single UI control to startDateFrom/startDateTo only, since the design's one filter can't address both pairs simultaneously without inventing a second control the design doesn't show.

Folder/Tag Filter: the design shows a single-select dropdown, but AssignFolderTagRequest's analogous field and ContractSearchRequest.folderTagIds are arrays (multi-select). I implemented a single-select control that produces a one-element folderTagIds array, matching the design's visual over the DTO's multi-select capability; multi-select wasn't shown anywhere in the TARGET DESIGN.

IndexingInProgressBanner: this component is listed in CLAUDE.md's module table and the life-cycle-uc8-uc9 skill, but is absent from this task's 'What you own' and from context.json's components list. I built it anyway because UC8-AF-004 (full text search indexing-exclusion notice) is explicitly one of this task's assigned stories and cannot be satisfied without it; no other task in this module claims it.

Added a small '+ Tag' action in each table row (not shown in the TARGET DESIGN) that opens the already-built AddFolderTagDialog for that contract, inferred from UC8-MF-001's acceptance criterion 'Given I click the Add Folder/Tag button on a contract I am authorized to tag... the dialog opens' — the design images show no per-row affordance for this, so I added the minimum control needed to satisfy the criterion without altering the rest of the table's visual layout.

indexingExcluded detection: ContractListItemResponse carries a per-item 'indexingInProgress' boolean but the contract doesn't specify how the frontend should learn that contracts were excluded from a text search. I infer the banner should show whenever a text search (searchText set) returns any item with indexingInProgress === true, rather than inventing a separate exclusion-count field the DTO doesn't declare.
